_readme: Batch of 13 (2 of the original 15 — Capital Vol. 1 and A Room of One's Own — are not on gutenberg.org and were skipped, not fabricated).

books.title: The Waste Land
books.author: T. S. Eliot
books.synopsis: A fractured, five-part modernist poem moves through a spiritually barren postwar landscape — tarot readings, a sterile Thames, a drowned sailor — toward a closing invocation of Hindu wisdom and peace.

books.title: Death Comes for the Archbishop
books.author: Willa Cather
books.synopsis: A French priest is appointed the first bishop of the New Mexico territory and spends decades building the church across a vast, unforgiving frontier alongside his devoted friend and fellow missionary.

books.title: A Lost Lady
books.author: Willa Cather
books.synopsis: A young man's idolatry of a charming railroad captain's wife curdles into disillusionment as her husband's fortune collapses and her secret affairs come to light.

books.title: The Professor's House
books.author: Willa Cather
books.synopsis: A historian nearing retirement retreats into his cramped old study, unable to let go of his life's work or the memory of a brilliant former student whose invention has enriched — and unsettled — his family.

books.title: Discourse on Method
books.author: René Descartes
books.synopsis: Descartes recounts abandoning inherited learning for a systematic method of doubt, arriving at his own existence as the one certainty from which reason can rebuild all knowledge.

books.title: The Social Contract
books.author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau
books.synopsis: Rousseau argues that legitimate political authority rests only on the consent of the governed, reconciling individual freedom with civic obligation through the collective 'general will.'

books.title: Barrack-Room Ballads
books.author: Rudyard Kipling
books.synopsis: Dialect verses give voice to the ordinary British soldier's swagger, homesickness, and fatalism across the far-flung outposts of empire.

books.title: Stalky & Co.
books.author: Rudyard Kipling
books.synopsis: Three cunning English schoolboys scheme, prank, and outmaneuver their masters at a seaside boarding school, turning every punishment into an opportunity for the next plot.

books.title: The Golden Bowl
books.author: Henry James
books.synopsis: An Italian prince's marriage to a wealthy American heiress is complicated by the arrival of her father's new wife, a woman from the prince's own past, in James's intricate late study of marriage and betrayal.

books.title: The Ambassadors
books.author: Henry James
books.synopsis: A middle-aged American is sent to Paris to bring home a wealthy widow's wayward son, only to find himself seduced by the very European sophistication he was meant to rescue him from.

books.title: The Awkward Age
books.author: Henry James
books.synopsis: A young woman's coming-of-age forces her mother's sophisticated London drawing-room circle to confront how much of their frank talk a girl on the edge of adulthood should be allowed to hear.

books.title: The Sacred Fount
books.author: Henry James
books.synopsis: A house-party guest becomes obsessed with a theory that one lover can secretly drain another's youth and wit, and pursues the idea past all evidence and reason.

books.title: Civil Disobedience
books.author: Henry David Thoreau
books.synopsis: Thoreau argues that individual conscience outranks civil law, and defends his refusal to pay taxes to a government that upholds slavery and wages an unjust war.
